title: Replace bcf_hdr_id2int with pure Rust HashMap lookup
description: Replace bcf_hdr_id2int FFI call (7 lines, hash table lookup) with pure Rust HashMap. This is a high-value leaf: it unlocks bcf_get_fmt, bcf_get_info_values, bcf_get_format_values, bcf_update_info, bcf_update_format, bcf_translate, and more. Used extensively in src/bcf/header.rs and src/bcf/record.rs. Complexity: trivial.
